title: BulletManhunt
description: A Simple And Light Weight Manhunt Plugin
body:
# **BulletManhunt** – Minecraft Manhunt Plugin with Hunter Compass

Take your Minecraft manhunt games to the next level with **BulletManhunt**! This plugin adds a fun and competitive twist by giving hunters a tracking compass to locate runners, while runners must survive and can even win by defeating the **Ender Dragon**.


# ⚡ Features:

🏃‍♂️ Roles: Players can join as Hunters or Runners using simple commands.

🧭 Hunter Compass: Hunters get a special compass that will track runner in their world.


# 🎮 Easy Commands:

- /bulletmanhunt start – Start the game.
- /bulletmanhunt stop – Stop the game.    
- /bulletmanhunt reset – Force reset the game.
- /bulletmanhunt reload - Reloads the plugin.
- /bulletmanhunt join hunter – Join as Hunter.
- /bulletmanhunt join runner – Join as Runner.

- 💡 Simple & Fun: Lightweight, easy to configure, and perfect for server manhunt events

# ✈️ Installation

- Download BulletManhunt-1.0.jar
- Place it in your /plugins folder
- Restart your server
- Configure config.yml as needed
- Use /bulletmanhunt reload to apply changes

# ❓ Why choose BulletManhunt?

- Adds competitive thrill for players.
- Easy to use and integrate in any server.
